This change reflects a reevaluation of risk versus reward, prompting some to take profits. Since mid-July, the company's stock has struggled below the IPO threshold, following a series of declines and an overall downturn in SpaceX's market value.

title: Quote of the day by Philip Fisher: "Change creates opportunities to grow, but it also creates opportunities to slip"

Whether in investing, business or life, success depends on embracing change while carefully managing uncertainty and avoiding impulsive choices.

title: Sebi proposes raising annual ISIN limit for private debt securities to 17
